page.title: Human Resources
page.description: The Human Resources site is where the Moonlight Resources team goes for people-related support. HR Documents covers forms, templates and general people paperwork, and Policies and Procedures sets out what's expected of employees and managers alike — from leave and conduct through to workplace health and safety. If you have a question about how something people-related is meant to work, start here.
